The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To understand blockchain technology, imagine a shared notebook that everyone in a large group has a copy of. Instead of one person holding the only notebook, every person in the group keeps an identical record. If someone wants to write a new entry, they shout it out to the group. Everyone checks their own notebook to make sure the new entry makes sense and hasn't been written before. If most people agree it's valid, they all write it down in their own notebooks at the same time. Because everyone has a copy, no single person can secretly erase or change a past entry without everyone else noticing. This makes the record very secure and trustworthy, as it is decentralized (not controlled by one person) and immutable (hard to change once written).
